Question Choices: Select which you would measure in meters: ~~spoon | swimming-pool | crayon | sticker~~
Solution: A swimming pool is large, so meters are convenient. Spoons, crayons and stickers are small and are usually measured in centimeters.

Question Choices: Select which unit would probably be used to measure how long a hallway is?: ~~Centimeters | Meters~~
Solution: A hallway is a long space. Meters give a convenient count compared with centimeters.

Question Choices: Select which you would measure in centimeters: ~~eraser | school-bus | soccer-field | house~~
Solution: An eraser is small, so centimeters are convenient. The bus, field and house are much larger.

Question Choices: Select which is closest to how long a shoe is: ~~25-centimeters | 25-meters~~
Hints: Think about how big a meter is.
Solution: A shoe can be about 25 centimeters long. Twenty-five meters would be far too long.

Question Choices: Select which is closest to how tall a flagpole is?: ~~20-feet | 20-inches~~
Hints: A flagpole is much taller than a ruler.
Solution: A flagpole is much taller than a ruler. Twenty feet is reasonable; twenty inches is too short.
